svg.title: Assistant-only fault injections and detected positions
svg.desc: Three controlled in-memory synthetic label mutations audited through the public assistant-only topology API.
svg.text: Assistant-only fault injections and detected positions
Executed through public audit_label_topology · controlled in-memory mutations, not CLI inputs or outputs
SYNTHETIC LABEL MUTATIONS · NO TOKENIZER / LOSS / MODEL / TRAINER / DATASET / GPU
Green = valid assistant target · red = injected off-policy supervision · amber outline = omitted eligible target
These rows prove detection behavior for deliberately altered label arrays. The CLI itself accepts traces, constructs its own valid policies, and did not receive these mutations.
Fixture: healthy-multiturn · policy: assistant_only · positions are zero-based and half-open runs
